- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Na Pali Coast can be explored by boat, kayak, or on foot.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Kauai Coffee Company is the largest coffee plantation in Hawaii, offering tours and tastings.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Wailua River State Park features hiking trails, waterfalls, and a historic Hawaiian village.
